title: Tension pneumothorax
summary: A vehicle commander took a rifle round to the right chest. He is struggling to breathe and getting worse as air builds up in the chest.
objectives: Recognise tension pneumothorax (breathing, chest inspection, stethoscope) and decompress it
Know what a decompression does without tension: it makes the pneumothorax worse
Definitive care: thoracostomy, chest tube, keep the patient lying
Support airway and breathing while unconscious; SpO2 above 90 % at the end
